description: This source file defines a SwiftUI view ('SystemRunSettingsView') and related supporting classes and models for managing system run approval settings in a macOS application. It includes user interface components for selecting agents, security policies, allowlists, and various configuration options, as well as a state management class ('ExecApprovalsSettingsModel') that handles fetching, updating, and persisting settings asynchronously.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsModel
classes.description: Observable class managing user settings for execution approval policies, allowing fetching, updating, validation, and management of agent-specific or default settings.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistEntry
classes.description: Data structure representing an allowlist entry with pattern matching and metadata.

classes.name: SystemRunSettingsView
classes.description: SwiftUI view providing the user interface for managing system run approval settings, including agent selection, security policies, allowlists, and related controls.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and updates the list of agents and loads settings for the currently selected agent.

methods.name: refreshAgents
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of agents from persistent storage.

methods.name: selectAgent
methods.description: Sets the current agent and loads its settings.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads settings for a specified agent ID, defaulting to defaults if applicable.

methods.name: setSecurity
methods.description: Updates the security policy and persists the change.

methods.name: setAsk
methods.description: Updates the 'ask' policy and persists the change.

methods.name: setAutoAllowSkills
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-allow for skill CLI detection and updates cache accordingly.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist pattern after validation, updating persisted allowlist.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing allowlist entry and persists changes.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an allowlist entry by ID and updates persisted allowlist.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves an allowlist entry by ID.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Validates whether a pattern string is a valid path pattern.

methods.name: refreshSkillBins
methods.description: Fetches current skill bins for auto-allow feature, optionally forcing refresh.
